commands.add task: to add a prioritized task to queue
commands.view tasks: to view all tasks sorted by priority
commands.delete task <num>: to remove a task by index
commands.run <app/url>: to execute an app or URL directly
commands.search <query>: to search Google directly in Chrome
commands.note <text>: to record a quick persistent note
commands.telemetry: to fetch live environmental weather data
